Its negative cosine root enters (-1,0) exactly at a<6b, giving six vs four vertices and cubic degeneracy at a=6b. The evolute E=p prime t-p doubleprime n has symmetric local coordinates Ex even, Ey=4(a-6b cos u)sin³u odd. At a=6b-delta the closure u0=acos(a/(6b)) identifies transverse endpoints, with interior ordinary cusp and two additional cusps; coordinate turning and tangent slope tan u rule out hidden self intersections near collapse. Under u=s sqrt(delta/b), scaled limit C1 curve X=-6s²+15s^4,Y=-4s³+12s^5 and endpoints ±1/sqrt3. Independent exact SymPy integral ∫X Y prime ds = -128 sqrt3/8505 verifies the area leading coefficient and exponent delta^(9/2)/b^(5/2).

value.rationale: The 2,3-harmonic support family is a natural low-complexity Fourier model of convex oval vertex birth/death. Exact three-cusp evolute-loop geometry with a sharp noninteger 9/2 enclosed-area collapse quantifies a singularity not settled by the qualitative four-vertex bound, and is a motivated local invariant rather than an arbitrary coefficient.

limitations: 0<b<1/26 fixed, a=6b-delta with delta small positive; no universal exponent for arbitrary ovals or classification of complete evolute.
